sentences.en: The products also contain no menthol, alcohol or sodium lauryl sulfate.

sentences.en: Some contain a surfactant called sodium lauryl sulfate, which is a common cause of reactions, particularly in people with eczema.

sentences.en: The sulfates (such as sodium lauryl sulfate and sodium laureth sulfate) are detergents that are commonly used in soaps and shampoos because they are inexpensive and make a lot of foam.
sentences.vi: Các sulfat (chẳng hạn như natri lauryl sulfat và natri laureth sulfat) là chất tẩy rửa thường được sử dụng trong xà phòng và dầu gội đầu vì chúng rẻ tiền và tạo nhiều bọt.

sentences.en: Sodium lauryl sulfate (SLS), a component of some toothpastes, is a potential cause of canker sores.
sentences.vi: Sodium lauryl sulfate (SLS), một thành phần của một số loại kem đánh răng, là nguyên nhân tiềm ẩn gây ra vết loét.

sentences.en: For this reason you will see ingredients like sodium lauryl sulfate, Cocamide DEA, Parabens, glycerin, citric acid, and many other familiar but phonetically complicated agents.

sentences.en: There is a large controversy surrounding ingredients such as sodium lauryl and sodium laureth sulfates.
sentences.vi: Có một cuộc tranh cãi lớn xung quanh các thành phần như natri lauryl và natri laureth sulfat.

sentences.en: This is why he has formulated his personal hair care line, Jonathan Product, using de-ionized water, and has ensured that each of his fabulous shampoos and styling aids are completely free of sodium lauryl sulfates.

sentences.en: This shampoo boasts the avoidance of Sodium Lauryl Sulfate during its formulation.
